description: The plot illustrates the average repetition rate across different relation categories for three distinct configurations, comparing their performance. The x-axis, labeled "Relation Category", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 60, and is marked at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled "Average Repetition Rate", also has a linear scale, spans from 0.0 to 0.6, and is marked at intervals of 0.1. The blue line, representing "w/o DPO obo", starts at approximately 0.03, peaks at around 0.58 at category 3, and ends at about 0.25 at category 55, with notable fluctuations throughout. The orange line, representing "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint", begins at roughly 0.23, reaches a peak of approximately 0.65 at category 37, and concludes at around 0.13 at category 55, also showing significant variability. The green line, representing "DPO", commences at about 0.03, attains a maximum of roughly 0.23 at category 7, and terminates at approximately 0.17 at category 55, generally remaining lower than the other two lines. Additionally, the average repetition rates for "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" and "DPO" are indicated by dashed orange and green lines, respectively, at values of 0.227 and 0.117.
